We bought this for our 4 year old son, he loves it. It is very easy to set up, inflates in 1 minute and ready for use. It does take some time to put it away, but that's fine. Fits in the car boot easily with the blower, not too heavy, easy to transport. We are very satisfied with the purchase, at this price it is unbeatable, containts a slide and bounce part as well. My son can spend hours jumping on it, so he is very happy with it too. 5 star easily

This inflatable bouncy house is the most satisfying toy I bought this summer. The castle design is especially appealing to my child. When it's hot, we fill it with water for slides and water ring toss; when it's cool, we leave it dry for simple bouncing and basketball. One set offers two ways to play. The fabric is durable and waterproof, the seams are sturdy, and it remains stable and doesn't deform even when multiple children are playing at the same time. It's also easy to clean, making it perfect for families with young children.

Great bouncy castle for kids up to 8-9 years. As it’s made of nylon it’s not giving the same bounce as the professional ones, but it’s great for smaller kids up to 45kg 6 at the time. The fan easily inflate it within seconds and is quite silent. Quality seems good. The first shipment was damaged (I think by the delivery company) but vevor sent us quickly a new.

After we got it, it became the kids' favorite play equipment. It combines four play elements—bounce, slide, basketball, and throwing—in one design, enough for multiple children to play together. The inflatable fabric is thick and sturdy, providing excellent support after inflation without any issues of collapsing or deforming. It's easy to operate, inflating and deflating quickly and effortlessly. Suitable for everyday home use or holiday events, it's highly recommended for families with multiple children.

This inflatable bouncy house is specially designed for family outdoor gatherings, integrating multiple play areas so children can take turns experiencing different activities. The overall inflatable structure is soft and provides good cushioning, eliminating worries about falls and bumps. It can accommodate several children at the same time, making it suitable for younger children. The inflation fan operates quietly, and the fabric is waterproof and stain-resistant; it can be easily wiped clean, making it very practical.

We often invite the neighbor's kids over to play on weekends, and this inflatable bouncy castle solves the problem of where our children have nowhere to release their energy. It combines bouncing, sliding, basketball, and throwing games, offering maximum fun, and can comfortably accommodate multiple children without feeling crowded. The fabric is very durable, and it doesn't leak even after repeated inflation and use. The edges are soft and without hard corners, giving parents peace of mind. It can be placed in the yard or indoors.
